newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian '96 primary aluminium output 2.87 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russian '96 primary aluminium output 2.87 mln T.

text.p: Russian output of primary aluminium in 1996 was 2.87 million tonnes, according to figures on Friday from the Konstern Alyuminiy producers' group.
The group's deputy director for development and investments, Galina Stelmakova, said the figure was final and replaced an earlier group estimate putting output at 2.79 million tonnes.
She said the group had not finished compiling export data and forecasts.
Russian primary aluminium output in 1997 would grow by 1.5-2.0 percent on 1996's level, she said.
Total primary aluminium output in the Commonwealth of Independent States last year was 3.16 million tonnes, including 198,300 tonnes in Tajikistan and 89,900 tonnes in Ukraine.
Kontsern Alyuminiy data from December 1996 put Russia's 1996 primary aluminium exports at 2.37 million tonnes, up from 1995's 2.11 million tonnes.
